pages.text:
A solid box of Condenser Array Casings, 3 to 7 blocks each way. It turns Exhaust Steam back into water, 1 mB for 1 mB.
# Cooling
- 400 mB/t in open air per 27 blocks of its size: a 7×7×7 condenses 5,081 mB/t.
- Each water source touching its outside adds 20 mB/t; ice 30, packed ice 40, blue ice 60. A bigger box has more outside to touch.
- Cold biomes condense ×1.25, the Nether only ×0.5. Never more than 800 mB/t per 27 blocks: a 7×7×7 tops out at 10,163 mB/t. In open air it already takes the biggest turbine's 4,200 mB/t of exhaust.
- Its tanks hold 16,000 mB per 27 blocks.
# Closing the loop
Boiler → Turbine (Exhaust port) → Condenser → back to the Boiler's water port. The ports push on their own, as fast as it condenses, so the loop runs without a pump.
